transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. As you know, the battery-charging room was closed after its smoke alarm sounded during the afternoon charging cycle. The visible smoke has cleared, but we need this room for the next production shift's battery charging. As Plant Safety Officer, it's my call whether we reopen and under what conditions. Per our incident-response routine, I need to hear from facilities, production supervision, and environmental compliance — in that order. Each of you will report your inspection findings and any required controls from your area. Please be ready to formally document your findings as well. Let's start with facilities. What did your inspection find?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: During my inspection of the battery-charging room after the alarm, I found that the sprinkler isolation valve had been left closed during a prior pipe repair. Facilities procedure requires reopening the valve and completing a pressure test before the room can be used. I have not yet entered the repair closeout record because the inspection occurred during the active incident response.
